requirement: Before an entry in an age-restricted division is counted ready, heat-planned or floor-scheduled, the organizer must record an eligibility determination (user id, timestamp, outcome, reason code; no birthdates) with outcome eligible and reason 'age division verified by organizer'. A waiver never clears an age-restricted entry, and no status or waiver lifts the OD-02 adult-only check, which is re-verified from the competitors' stored dates of birth (fails closed). Copy states that DanceFlow does not yet automatically verify governing-body age divisions.

tests.name: a waiver never clears an age-restricted entry
refuses a waiver on an age-restricted division, a wrong reason, and a missing reason

enforcement_point: Server: updateCompetitionEntryEligibilityAction (writes the determination, refuses unsupported decisions); loadEntryOperationalGates in heat generation, floor schedule loader and readiness page.
interpretation_notes: PARTIALLY implemented, so not marked verified. Gaps: (1) entries become 'confirmed' inside start_competition_registration / finalize (SQL) without any eligibility determination, so confirmation itself is not gated, only downstream scheduling, heat planning and readiness; (2) check-in (checkin/actions.ts) and day-of paths still use the older eligible-or-waived test and were not changed; (3) DOB re-verification relies on competitors.date_of_birth, which is set at registration and not otherwise audited; (4) organizer determinations live in entries.metadata (no dedicated audit table, no append-only history: a later change overwrites the previous determination) - a reliable audit trail and a DB-level guard need a separate SQL approval; (5) whose age counts for Pro-Am and Couples is unresolved (AE-16, NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE): the software never infers it and relies on the organizer.
